import base64, hashlib, io, json, subprocess, sys, tempfile, zipfile
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('products/distribution/sqlite-paid-education-shelf/free-preview')
receipt = json.loads((root / 'verification.json').read_text())
expected = receipt['payload_sha256']
payloads = ['README.md', 'after.sql', 'before.sql', 'run.py', 'seed.sql']
assert set(expected) == set(payloads)
archive = io.BytesIO()
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive, 'w', compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as output:
    for name in payloads:
        data = (root / name).read_bytes()
        assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == expected[name], name
        member = zipfile.ZipInfo(name, (1980, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0))
        member.compress_type = zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
        output.writestr(member, data)
encoded = base64.b64encode(archive.getvalue())
archive_bytes = base64.b64decode(encoded, validate=True)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(archive_bytes)) as staged:
        assert staged.namelist() == payloads
        for name in payloads:
            data = staged.read(name)
            assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == expected[name], name
            (Path(directory) / name).write_bytes(data)
    run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'run.py'], cwd=directory, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10, check=True)
observed = json.loads(run.stdout)
previous = json.loads(receipt['stdout'])
for field in ('before', 'after'):
    assert observed[field] == previous[field], field
manifest = {'scope': 'Staged fictional free preview. Paid archive rights, seller activation, publication and sales are separate.', 'archive_sha256': hashlib.sha256(archive_bytes).hexdigest(), 'archive_bytes': len(archive_bytes), 'members_sha256': expected, 'learner_command': 'python3 run.py', 'exit': run.returncode, 'observed': observed}
(root / 'sqlite-preview.zip.b64').write_bytes(encoded + b'\n')
(root / 'archive-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(manifest))
